about.title: Who We Are
paragraphs: Hope for All Ministries MENA operates under the Evangelical Synod of the Nile in Egypt.
We exist to serve the Church and society by producing and disseminating Reformed Christian biblical thought that is deeply rooted in Scripture and thoughtfully engaged with today's challenges.
We believe that true renewal in the Church begins with a return to authentic biblical teaching, faithfully interpreted and clearly communicated for our time.

pillars.title: Our Vision
pillars.text: To contribute to the renewal of the Church through biblically grounded, intellectually sound, and culturally relevant Christian publishing.

pillars.title: Our Mission
pillars.text: To produce, translate, and distribute Christian resources that strengthen biblical faith, engage contemporary intellectual challenges, and equip churches, families, and future leaders.

items.title: Publishing Christian theological and cultural thought

lists.title: Why This Ministry Matters
items: Christian books are becoming less accessible due to rising costs.
The Church needs trustworthy, biblically rooted resources.
A new generation of Christian writers needs training and support.
Faith today must respond wisely to postmodern and cultural challenges.
Your support enables us to move from limited access to lasting influence.

lists.title: How You Can Make an Impact
items: Equip churches with reliable biblical content
lists.outro: Partner with us in shaping minds, strengthening faith, and impacting generations.
